high_level_description: The image depicts a woman at a gas station, refueling a red sports car. She is also wearing a black baseball cap with a white logo on the front and a leopard-print face mask. The setting appears to be outdoors during the daytime, as indicated by the bright lighting and shadows. The gas pump is a standard model with a hose connected to it, and there is a warning label visible on the pump.
